task: Wire up free open-source art/editing stack into repos (owner 2026-10-10)
resume_brief: Owner 2026-10-10: 'Wire up all that's free and to my repos too for art and editing.' Build a free/open-source art+editing toolkit and wire it into his repos. Stack: rembg (background removal), BiRefNet/RMBG-2.0 (SOTA matting), LaMa (inpainting/object removal), Pillow + ImageMagick (compositing, text, color), ffmpeg (video cutting/captions), potrace (raster-to-vector for font work). Set it up as reusable tools: a shared tools/art-stack/ directory (pick the best home repo — font-wizard or a new spot) with install script, then wire entry points into font-wizard, media-pipeline, trippedd-studio so workers can call them. Document each tool: what it does, how to call it, example. No paid APIs, no subscriptions — free only. Branch → PR → merge.
notes: Complete 2026-10-11: art stack built+tested in font-wizard (PR #7 merged), media-pipeline bg_remove upgraded (local commit, no remote), trippedd-studio shim+docs (PR #123 merged), Pocket Studio server.py+Colab wired (local commit, no remote). venv manifest saved.
